title: Post-SQLFix: Property-Guided Repair of LLM-Generated SQL with Runtime Verification
title_zh: Post-SQLFix：基于属性引导与运行时验证的LLM生成SQL修复

paragraphs.en: Post-SQLFix通过属性引导与运行时验证修复LLM生成的SQL，修复77.8%执行错误并降低token用量。 Large Language Models (LLMs) for Text-to-SQL frequently generate queries with syntax errors, invalid identifier references, or violations of SQL scoping and typing rules. Repairing these errors is a program correctness problem, yet existing approaches rely on Execution Feedback (EF), whose symptom-level, dialect-specific error messages force the LLM to speculate on root causes. We identify an Arbitration Paradox in this paradigm: the system relies on unverified models both to propose repairs and to make the final judgment on whether those repairs satisfy the required properties. We resolve this paradox by reformulating Text-to-SQL repair as property-guided program repair. Our framework, Post-SQLFix, canonicalizes SQL into a dialect-aware Canonical Query Structure (CQS) and validates it through a hierarchical static analyzer with three stratified property layers (Syntactic, Context-Free Structural, Context-Sensitive Semantic). The analyzer produces precise, schema-aware violation diagnostics to guide the LLM's repair proposals. A Verify-Before-Apply Temporal Monitor then accepts only repairs that reduce the violation count, do not reintroduce resolved violations, and satisfy the operator contracts. These runtime invariants are bounded by the declared rule family and operator contracts, while a finite retry budget ensures halting. On three established benchmarks (BIRD, Spider, Mini-Dev) spanning over 3,000 evaluation instances, three SQL dialects (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL), and six model configurations, Post-SQLFix resolves 77.8% of the execution errors that EF leaves unrepaired, while requiring less than half as many repair iterations and 30% fewer tokens. Crucially, accepted transitions under the monitor introduce no statically detectable structural regressions in our evaluation, translating checked repair fidelity into absolute accuracy improvements of up to +11.6 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: Post-SQLFix通过属性引导与运行时验证修复LLM生成的SQL，修复了77.8%的执行错误并降低了token用量。用于Text-to-SQL的大语言模型（LLM）经常生成存在语法错误、无效标识符引用或违反SQL作用域与类型规则的查询。 修复这些错误本质上是一个程序正确性问题，然而现有方法依赖执行反馈（EF），其症状层面、方言相关的错误信息迫使LLM去猜测根本原因。 我们在这一范式中发现了一个仲裁悖论：系统依赖未经验证的模型来提出修复方案，同时又依赖它对修复方案是否满足所需属性做出最终判断。 我们通过将Text-to-SQL修复重新表述为属性引导的程序修复来解决这一悖论。 我们提出的框架Post-SQLFix将SQL规范化为方言感知的规范化查询结构（CQS），并通过一个包含三层分层属性（语法层、上下文无关结构层、上下文相关语义层）的层次化静态分析器对其进行验证。 该分析器产生精确的、模式感知的违规诊断信息，以引导LLM提出修复方案。 随后，“先验证后应用”的时序监控器仅接受那些能减少违规数量、不会重新引入已解决违规、且满足算子契约的修复方案。 这些运行时不变量由声明的规则族和算子契约所约束，而有限的重试预算则确保了停机性。 在涵盖超过3,000个评估实例、三种SQL方言（SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL）和六种模型配置的三个成熟基准（BIRD、Spider、Mini-Dev）上，Post-SQLFix解决了EF未能修复的77.8%的执行错误，同时所需的修复迭代次数不到一半，token用量减少30%。 至关重要的是，在我们的评估中，监控器下被接受的转换不会引入任何静态可检测的结构性退化，从而将经过检查的修复保真度转化为高达+11.6个百分点的绝对准确率提升。
